Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a family-owned Swiss company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. Emilley AG St. Gallen is an official sales and service partner of the Jaguar, Landrover, Toyota, Lexus, Suzuki, Mitsubishi, Subaru and Zeekr brands and also has a carrosserie and a spare part warehouse. Your tasks
• Performing service and repair work according to the manufacturer's specifications
• Checking the functionality of various components
• Diagnosis with the help of the workshop manager
• Regular participation in training courses and further trainings Your profile
• Completed vocational training as an automotive mechatronics engineer
• Continuing training or interest in continuing training as an automotive diagnostician
• You are self-employed, capable of teaming and have a quality awareness
• Good German knowledge in word and writing
• Guide ID Cat. B What we offer You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• A private, attractive pension fund as an independent pension institution
• A long-term company perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of holidays How to contact us Daniela Bühler, Regional Personnel Manager, is looking forward to the complete Application (including CV, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better readability, the simultaneous use of the language forms male, female and divers (m/w/d) is waived. Female and other gender identities are explicitly mentioned. For us, diversity also means that people in teams work together, who achieve the best possible results through their uniqueness and diversity. We are convinced that a diverse workforce, as well as an inclusive culture, will enable us to exploit our full potential.
• Performing service and repair work according to the manufacturer's specifications
• Checking the functionality of various components
• Diagnosis with the help of the workshop manager
• Regular participation in training courses and further training courses specific to the individual areas
• Completed vocational training as an automotive mechatronics engineer
• Continuing training or interest in continuing training as an automotive diagnostician
• You are self-employed, able to team and have a quality awareness
• Good German knowledge in word and writing
• Guide ID Cat. B

Description The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive sector. The activities focus on the importation of automotive brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG Volketswil is the official sales and service partner of the Mercedes Benz, Kia, Opel, Mazda and Suzuki brands and has a body shop and a spare parts warehouse.
• Responsibilities - Perform maintenance, repair and inspection work on vehicles from Mazda, Opel and Suzuki - Diagnosis and resolution of mechanical, electrical and mechatronic problems - Perform warranty and recall work according to the manufacturer's specifications - Ensure high-quality work and service - Collaborate actively with service consultants and the workshop team for optimal customer management
• Requirements - Professional school diploma as a mechatronic technician EFZ and more than 5 years of work experience - Experience with one or more of our reference brands (not mandatory) - Ability to work independently, efficiently and meticulously - Passion for the automotive sector and willingness to maintain ongoing training with new technologies - Good knowledge of the German language in writing and speaking - Category B driving license
• What we offer - Numerous benefits (new and used vehicles, maintenance and repair work, spare parts, vehicle and illness insurance, fuel cards, hotels and more) - An attractive old-age pension as an independent pension fund - A long-term career perspective - Possibility of individual training and development - Minimum 25 days of vacation Contact Chiara Staccioli, Regional Personnel Manager, will be pleased to receive your complete application (e.g. curriculum, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For readability reasons, we have decided not to use the grammatical form male, female and diverse (m/w/d). Women and other gender identities are explicitly included. We are convinced that a heterogeneous team and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

• Événements : vous travaillez activement sur les expositions et les événements des clients
• Expérience de vente : vous apportez au moins deux ou trois ans d'expérience de vente réussie, préférablement dans l'industrie automobile ou le secteur des services
• Passion pour l'automobile : vous avez une grande passion pour l'industrie automobile et êtes enthousiasmé par la vente d'automobiles
• Personnalité gagnante : le contact avec le client est votre force absolue. Vous convainquez avec un comportement sûr et raffiné, ainsi qu'avec un fort flair de vente
• Mentalité de service : une forte orientation client, un haut idée de service et des compétences de négociation sont vos caractéristiques
• Flexibilité : vous êtes résilient, prêt à apprendre et apportez la volonté de travailler le samedi
• Compétence linguistique : vous vous exprimez avec confiance en allemand et avez de bonnes connaissances en anglais. D'autres langues étrangères comme le français ou l'italien sont un grand avantage
• Volonté de réussite : vous avez un vrai mindset de gagnant avec un focus sur l'atteinte des objectifs et une grande initiative personnelle
• Mobilité : vous avez un permis de conduire valide de catégorie B Ce que nous offrons à vous. Vous trouverez avec nous une nouvelle challenge avec des tâches excitantes et beaucoup d'autres choses encore :
• De nombreuses avantages (véhicules neufs et d'occasion, travaux de service et pièces de rechange, assurance, cartes de carburant, hôtels et beaucoup d'autres choses)
• Une pension attractive comme une caisse de pension indépendante
• Une perspective d'entreprise à long terme
• Des opportunités individuelles de formation et de développement
• Au moins 25 jours de vacances Comment vous pouvez nous contacter. Chiara Staccioli, responsable régionale du personnel, se réjouit de votre demande de candidature complète (par exemple, curriculum vitae, attestations de travail, etc.) via le lien "Candidater maintenant !" Pour une meilleure lisibilité, nous avons décidé de ne pas utiliser simultanément les formes grammaticales masculines, féminines et diverses (m/w/d). Les femmes et les autres identités de genre sont explicitement incluses. La diversité signifie pour nous que les personnes travaillent dans des équipes qui, en raison de leur unicité et de leur diversité, atteignent les meilleurs résultats. Nous sommes convaincus que des équipes diversifiées et une culture intégrative nous permettent d'exploiter notre plein potentiel.

Cosa dovresti sapere su di noi Il gruppo Emil Frey non è solo un'azienda familiare svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle aziende leader nel settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri principali dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è l'importazione di marchi automobilistici, la gestione di officine, la logistica di pezzi di ricambio e accessori e la fornitura di servizi finanziari. La nostra cultura aziendale si basa sulla fiducia reciproca, sulla vicinanza alle persone e su una vera collaborazione a tutti i livelli. Siamo convinti che il successo sostenibile si verifichi laddove le persone si sentono ascoltate, supportate e sviluppate. È proprio qui che entra in gioco il nostro lavoro nel campo delle risorse umane: vicino alle sedi, in uno scambio diretto con manager e dipendenti e con l'obiettivo di dare forma attivamente alle cose. Ecco perché stiamo cercando te: una personalità delle risorse umane con cuore, competenza e volontà di fare davvero la differenza. I vostri compiti – versatili e vicini alle persone
• Siete il primo punto di contatto per dirigenti e collaboratori in diverse sedi e supportate tutte le questioni HR dall'assunzione alla partenza
• Vi assumete il reclutamento indipendente di specialisti e manager e accompagnate l'intero processo di selezione
• Partecipate attivamente ai processi di cambiamento e li accompagnate in modo professionale e orientato alla soluzione
• Siete responsabili dell'intera amministrazione delle risorse umane lungo tutto il ciclo di vita dei dipendenti
• Consigliate e supportate i superiori di linea nei processi HR centrali annuali Il vostro profilo – tecnicamente competente e personalmente convincente
• Formazione commerciale di base con perfezionamento in gestione delle risorse umane (almeno federale. Certificato di specializzazione)
• Esperienza professionale pluriennale in una posizione comparabile
• Tedesco parlato e scritto elegante
• Sei una personalità proattiva, pragmatica e indipendente, impegnata e orientata alle soluzioni
• Elevata flessibilità e disponibilità a essere presente in luoghi diversi
• È necessaria una licenza di viaggio perché lavori in loco a rotazione Cosa ti offriamo Da noi troverai una nuova sfida con compiti entusiasmanti e molto altro ancora:
• Tanto spazio per l'iniziativa personale e la partecipazione: contribuisci con le tue idee e lasci il tuo segno attivamente coinvolto nel lavoro delle risorse umane
• Numerosi vantaggi (auto nuove e usate, autovetture nuove e usate, lavori di assistenza e pezzi di ricambio, assicurazione veicolo e assicurazione sanitaria, carte carburante, hotel e molto altro)
• La nostra attraente cassa pensioni come cassa pensione indipendente
• Una prospettiva aziendale a lungo termine
• Opportunità di formazione e sviluppo individuali

Per ragioni di migliore leggibilità le forme linguistiche maschile, femminile e diverso (m/f/d) non vengono utilizzate contemporaneamente. Le identità femminili e di altro genere sono espressamente incluse. Per noi diversità significa anche che le persone lavorano insieme in team che ottengono i migliori risultati possibili grazie alla loro unicità e differenze. Crediamo che una forza lavoro diversificata e una cultura inclusiva ci consentano di raggiungere il nostro pieno potenziale.

Les activités sont axées sur l'importation de marques automobiles, l'exploitation de garages, la logistique de pièces de rechange et d'accessoires, ainsi que la fourniture de services financiers. Notre culture d'entreprise vit du recul mutuel, de la proximité avec les personnes et de la collaboration authentique à tous les niveaux. Nous sommes convaincus que le succès durable se développe là où les personnes se sentent écoutées, soutenues et développées. Exactement là commence notre travail RH : proche des lieux de travail, en échange direct avec les dirigeants et les employés et avec l'objectif de contribuer activement. • Vous travaillez activement sur les processus de changement et les accompagnez de manière professionnelle et orientée vers les solutions
• Vous êtes responsable de l'administration RH complète le long du cycle de vie de l'employé

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG Biel is the official sales and/or service partner of the brands Subaru, Jaguar / Land Rover, Toyota, Kia, and Suzuki. We are looking for reinforcement for our team in Biel as of May 1, 2026 or by agreement. Your tasks
• You take care of the success-oriented and active sales of our broad model palette
• From the first contact, you care for our customers, advise them on the vehicle selection and the various financing and insurance options
• You ensure the successful delivery of the vehicle and the follow-up contact (especially customer satisfaction)
• The daily care of your existing customer base and the acquisition of new customers are part of your tasks, as well as the management and care of the vehicle park
• The care of our online appearance of the vehicles (announcement, photos, etc.)
• The help with events/exhibitions and the close cooperation with our departments (workshop, spare parts warehouse and customer service) is assumed Your profile
• Sales and consulting are fun for you
• You are a sales-oriented and strong negotiating personality and have already gained experience in sales and in the automotive industry (advantage)
• Your commercial flair, your customer and service orientation, and your communicative strength characterize you
• A high level of personal motivation, assertiveness, and passion for cars complete your profile
• You are fascinated by new technologies, trends, and IT and have a high level of flexibility and willingness to learn
• You speak at least two languages (DE and FR) and hold a category B driving license
• Your positive attitude enables you to easily integrate into a motivated and open team What we offer you
• You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• Your own attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation How to contact us Stefan Lanz, Administration Manager, looks forward to your complete application (e.g., curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For better readability, we have decided not to use the form of gender male, female, and diverse (m/w/d). Women and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work together in teams that, thanks to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best results. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you need to know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with over 100 years of experience, but it is also one of the leaders in the automotive sector. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. Its main activities are the importation of vehicles from global brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories, as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey SA La Chaux-de-Fonds is an official sales and service partner of the Toyota, Suzuki, Kia, Mitsubishi, and Subaru and Land Rover brands, and also has a body shop and a spare parts store. Your tasks
• Competent consultation and accompaniment of our customers during the purchase of a vehicle
• Sale of new and used vehicles from the company's brands, including complementary services (financing, leasing, insurance)
• Development and maintenance of long-term customer relationships
• Active acquisition of new customers (showroom, phone, online requests)
• Establishment of offers and treatment of purchase contracts
• Organization and conduct of road tests
• Maintenance and presentation of the vehicle park at the showroom
• Participation in specific brand training and courses Your profile
• Previous experience in sales, ideally in the automotive sector
• Passion for cars and pleasure of customer contact
• Convincing personality and negotiation talent
• Ability to work independently, structured, and goal-oriented
• High sense of service and customer orientation
• Good computer skills
• Category B driving license What we offer You will find with us a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Many discounts (new and used cars, workshop work, spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, etc.)
• An independent, healthy, and attractive pension fund
• A long-term company perspective
• Individual opportunities for ongoing training and development
• 25 minimum days of vacation How to contact us Christophe Poyard, Head of Administration, is pleased to receive your complete application (including CV, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Submit your application now". For reasons of legibility, we have refrained from using the linguistic forms masculine, feminine, and diverse (m/f/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. For us, diversity means also ensuring that people working in such teams achieve the best possible results through their individualities and differences. We are convinced that a diversified workforce and an inclusive culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Was Sie über uns wissen müssen Das Emil Frey-Unternehmen ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit über 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch einer der Führer im Automobilsektor. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die Grundpfeiler des Unternehmens. Seine Haupttätigkeiten sind die Importation von Fahrzeugen von globalen Marken, die Betreibung von Garagen, die Logistik von Ersatzteilen und Zubehör sowie die Bereitstellung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Emil Frey SA La Chaux-de-Fonds ist ein offizieller Verkaufs- und Servicepartner der Marken Toyota, Suzuki, Kia, Mitsubishi und Subaru und Land Rover und verfügt außerdem über einen Kfz-Betrieb und einen Ersatzteile-Lager. Ihre Aufgaben
• Kompetente Beratung und Begleitung unserer Kunden bei der Kaufentscheidung für ein Fahrzeug
• Verkauf von Neuwagen und Gebrauchtwagen der Marken des Unternehmens, einschließlich der zusätzlichen Dienstleistungen (Finanzierung, Leasing, Versicherungen)
• Entwicklung und Pflege von langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen
• Aktive Akquisition neuer Kunden (Showroom, Telefon, Online-Anfragen)
• Erstellung von Angeboten und Bearbeitung von Kaufverträgen
• Organisation und Durchführung von Fahrzeugtests
• Pflege und Präsentation des Fahrzeugparks im Showroom
• Teilnahme an spezifischen Marken-Trainings und Kursen Ihr Profil
• Vorausgehende Erfahrung im Verkauf, idealerweise im Automobilsektor
• Leidenschaft für Autos und Freude am Kundenkontakt
• Überzeugende Persönlichkeit und Verhandlungstalent
• Fähigkeit, unabhängig, strukturiert und zielorientiert zu arbeiten
• Hoher Service- und Kundenorientierungssinn
• Gute Computerkenntnisse
• Kfz-Führerschein der Kategorie B Was wir bieten Sie werden bei uns eine neue Herausforderung mit spannenden Aufgaben und vielem mehr finden:
• Viele Rabatte (Neuwagen und Gebrauchtwagen, Werkstattarbeiten, Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Benzin- und Hotelkarten, usw.)
• Eine unabhängige, gesunde und attraktive Pensionskasse
• Eine langfristige Unternehmensperspektive
• Individuelle Möglichkeiten für fortlaufende Weiterbildung und Entwicklung
• 25 Mindesttage Urlaub Wie Sie uns kontaktieren Christophe Poyard, Leiter der Verwaltung, freut sich, Ihre vollständige Bewerbung (einschließlich CV, Arbeitszeugnisse, usw.) über den Link "Bewerbung jetzt einreichen" zu erhalten. Aus Gründen der Lesbarkeit haben wir es unterlassen, gleichzeitig die sprachlichen Formen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/f/d) zu verwenden. Weibliche und andere Geschlechtsidentitäten sind ausdrücklich eingeschlossen. Für uns bedeutet Vielfalt auch, sicherzustellen, dass Personen, die in solchen Teams arbeiten, durch ihre Individualität und ihre Unterschiede die besten Ergebnisse erzielen können. Wir sind überzeugt, dass eine vielfältige Belegschaft und eine inklusive Kultur es uns ermöglichen, unser Potenzial voll auszuschöpfen.

L'Emil Frey Group non è solo una famiglia svizzera con oltre 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle aziende leader nel settore automotive. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri principali dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è sull'importazione di marchi di auto, il funzionamento di garage, la logistica di ricambio e accessori e la fornitura di servizi finanziari. Emil Frey Digital AG fa parte del Gruppo Emil Frey ed è un fornitore di servizi di comunicazione completo per l'industria automobilistica e responsabile della digitalizzazione all'interno del Gruppo Emil Frey. Stiamo costruendo la divisione AI a Emil Frey su Baue con noi la divisione AI nel Gruppo Emil Frey. Come team di nuova costituzione, forniamo la strategia AI e il modello operativo, sviluppiamo gli standard di governance insieme a sicurezza, legale, IT e dati e supportiamo le aree di business nel rendere l'IA misurabile nel business. Dal business case all'analisi del rischio alla valutazione di partner e soluzioni tecniche. Gestiamo il portafoglio AI della Svizzera, progetti di piombo, costruiamo agenti AI e flussi di lavoro automatizzati. A livello internazionale, garantiamo trasparenza sulle iniziative delle filiali nazionali in modo che le sinergie vengano utilizzate in tutto il Gruppo.
